title: Columbo
description:
S1 E1 — Murder by the Book
A blackmailer interferes with a mystery writer's scheme to kill his former partner in a perfect crime.

title: Columbo
description:
S1 E2 — Death Lends a Hand
Columbo investigates the case of an unfaithful wife who was murdered when she refused to be blackmailed.

title: Columbo
description:
S1 E3 — Dead Weight
No body, no weapon and a witness courted by the war hero she thinks committed murder, complicate a case.

title: Columbo
description:
S1 E4 — Suitable for Framing
Columbo is caught in a case of stolen art and murder with evidence pointing to an innocent woman.

title: Columbo
description:
S1 E5 — Lady in Waiting
A competition between bitter siblings for ownership of a family-owned corporation, after their father's untimely death, escalates into murder.

title: Columbo
description:
S1 E6 — Short Fuse
An explosion kills an executive as he calls his wife from a car phone, and suspicion falls on a company attorney.

title: Columbo
description:
S1 E7 — Blueprint for Murder
Columbo excavates the area surrounding the newly poured foundation of a building to search for a corpse.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E2 — The Greenhouse Jungle
A botanical collector involves his nephew in a kidnapping to break a trust fund, then murders him to finance his hobby.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E1 — Étude in Black
The mistress of a conductor becomes a target for murder after threatening to tell all to her lover's wife.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E3 — The Most Crucial Game
A football-team manager (Robert Culp) establishes an electronic alibi for the murder of the team owner (Dean Stockwell) during a game; guests Valerie Harper, Susan Howard, James Gregory, Dean Jagger.

title: Columbo
description:
S2 E4 — Dagger of the Mind
Columbo journeys to London to observe Scotland Yard, but winds up investigating murders committed by two Shakespearean actors.

title: Columbo
description:
S3 E3 — Candidate for Crime
A senatorial candidate exploits death threats, fabricated for publicity, to kill his manager.
